title: Constructible module maps into integral constant pushforwards factor through finite pushforwards
statement: For Noetherian X, finite commutative Lambda, constructible module sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], integral nu : Y -> X, finite Lambda-module M and phi : F -> nu_* M_Y, there exist finite f : Z -> X, psi : F -> f_* M_Z and kappa : f_* M_Z -> nu_* M_Y with psi followed by kappa equal to phi.

source.place: Tag 09Z6 proof of (1), factorization by Tag 09Z4, transferred to (3)

proof.text: Convert the finite-value trivializations of the constructible strata to finite locally constant sheaves using finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff. The Noetherian underlying space gives a source-library IsConstructibleSheaf witness via of_noetherianSpace. A finite coefficient ring is Noetherian; apply isFinitelyPresentable_of_isConstructibleSheaf.
Take the small filtered colimit presentation of the integral pushforward. IsFinitelyPresentable.exists_hom_of_isColimit supplies a stage i and p with p followed by its cocone map equal to phi.
Let e identify D_i with f_i,* M. Set psi = p followed by e.hom and kappa = e.inv followed by the cocone map. Cancel e.hom followed by e.inv to prove the factorization equality; f_i is finite.

theorem exists_finite_lowerStar_factorization
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X) [IsIntegralHom ν]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M]
    (φ : F ⟶ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : Z ⟶ X), IsFinite f ∧
      ∃ (ψ : F ⟶ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
        ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))
        (κ : (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
          ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) ⟶
          (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)),
        ψ ≫ κ = φ
